reason: Reproduced live: after Next is pressed on the empty Target balance rule form, a mutation observer saw the text Select rule frequency added to the page with no alert, status or aria-live ancestor, while the only live regions (the drag-and-drop announcer and the toast container) stayed empty and focus stayed on the Next button. Four fields carry aria-invalid and aria-errormessage, so the errors can be found by moving through the form, but nothing tells a screen-reader user that Next was refused. This is not the confirmation of a money movement, so it stays medium.
